Module org.jboss.resteasy.security.jose.jwt

module org.jboss.resteasy.security.jose.jwt
RESTEasy JOSE JWT module.

Provides JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE) and JSON Web Token (JWT) support for authentication and authorization.
